hook: A six-second molecular movie shows disorder spreading through a protein from one broken salt bridge
summary: Many proteins switch between folded and floppy states, but the spread of that change is rarely seen. Time-resolved crystallography captured 29 snapshots of a cryptochrome after light exposure, showing disorder start at one broken salt bridge and travel outward like a helix-to-coil change. It covers one protein in crystals, which may constrain motions seen in solution.
title: Mapping the Slow Propagation of Disorder across a Photoreceptor’s Tertiary Structure with Time-Resolved Crystallography
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
